g.text: tokens: prompt + completion of every trained sample (throughput_fair.csv); useful = samples with nonzero advantage. TRL and prime-rl drop zero-advantage groups before the trainer, so their useful = all

text.style: font-size: 7.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #52514e

g.text: forwarded: TRL logged (tree packing forwards each group's prompt once; inter-rank padding is stripped before the forward). verl, miles, prime-rl pack with no padding and OpenRLHF runs 1 unpadded sample per micro-batch, so forwarded = trained. SkyRL pads each sample to the step's max width
